technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven for dependency management and module extraction.
For U1, implement a fix for NPE when using Teradata JDBC driver directly, or integrate the Hortonworks Teradata connection manager as a fallback.
For U2, add a new configuration property 'logging.dir' to allow overriding the default logging directory.
For U3, U4, U5, extract the respective modules into separate Maven projects (spring-bus and spring-cloud-dataflow) and update Spring XD to depend on them via Maven coordinates.
For U6, implement a singlenode XD Admin SPI using Module Launcher that runs in a single JVM.
For U7, implement a Diego-based Receptor Admin SPI for Cloud Foundry Lattice/Diego integration.
For U8, investigate and prototype a mechanism for s-c-s modules to self-register with a service registry (e.g., Eureka).
assumptions: Developer is familiar with the Spring XD codebase and Spring Framework 6.0.
Existing unit and integration test infrastructure is in place and can be extended.
All development is performed on a single developer machine with standard Java development tools.
No external dependencies beyond standard Spring and Maven repositories are needed.
Effort estimates include design, coding, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation for each activity.
U8 results in a design document and a working prototype, not a production-ready feature.
All activities are performed sequentially; no parallel development is assumed.

activities.activity_description: Analyze all user stories, design the overall architecture, plan module extraction, define interfaces for new Admin SPI implementations, and document key decisions.

Investigate the NullPointerException when using Teradata JDBC driver directly, fix the issue, or integrate the Hortonworks Teradata connection manager. Implement necessary changes and test with sample import job.

Add a configuration property (e.g., 'xd.logging.dir') to allow users to set the logging directory outside xd.home. Update code to use this property and ensure backward compatibility. Write unit tests.

Create a new Maven project for the message-bus module, copy relevant source code and tests from Spring XD, set up proper dependencies, and update Spring XD to depend on the new artifact. Ensure all existing tests pass.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Move input/output type conversion to spring-cloud-dataflow
activities.activity_description: Extract the input/output type conversion code from Spring XD into a new module in the spring-cloud-dataflow project. Update Maven dependencies and integration points. Write tests for the extracted module.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Extract serialization codec into spring-bus
activities.activity_description: Extract the serialization codec code from Spring XD and add it to the existing spring-bus project (or a separate module). Ensure all serialization functionality works with the new dependency. Update tests.

Design and implement a 'singlenode' implementation of the XD Admin SPI using Module Launcher that runs in a single JVM. Integrate with existing stream management logic. Write unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Diego-based Receptor Admin SPI implementation
activities.activity_description: Research Cloud Foundry Diego and Lattice APIs, design and implement a Receptor-based Admin SPI. Implement module launching and lifecycle management. Write tests and verify against a local Diego environment (if available).

Investigate how s-c-s modules can self-register with a service discovery tool (e.g., Eureka). Design a prototype, implement a basic listener or annotation-based registration, and verify it works with a local service registry. Document findings.
Run end-to-end integration tests for all user stories together, fix any regressions or cross-story issues, and ensure the complete increment works as expected.

Write or update documentation for each user story: update user guide for U1 and U2, update developer documentation for module extraction and new Admin SPIs, and prepare release notes for the increment.
